title: ProgRouter: Online Progress-Guided Orchestration for Multi-Agent LLM Workflows under Quality-Cost Tradeoffs
title_zh: ProgRouter：面向质量—成本权衡的多智能体 LLM 工作流在线进度引导编排
abstract_en: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) workflows have emerged as a powerful paradigm for solving complex, open-ended tasks through collaborative reasoning among specialized LLM agents, but they incur substantial operating costs due to repeated LLM invocations and long-horizon context accumulation. Existing cascade routing methods make one-shot, query-level decisions and cannot adapt to the dynamic, state-dependent nature of multi-step workflows, in which the right LLM at each step depends on evolving task progress, remaining task difficulty, and cost-efficiency requirements. We present ProgRouter, an online progress-guided routing framework that adaptively selects LLM agents across workflow steps to preserve task-solving quality while adhering to time and cost budgets. ProgRouter introduces a multi-view task progress scorer that combines coarse workflow outcome regimes with fine-grained signals on subtask completion, progress trends, and workflow state quality. Then, a dual-path task progress predictor and an adaptive meta-gating mechanism estimate the progress gain for each candidate routed LLM. ProgRouter makes online step-wise routing decisions that balance progress gain, task time budgets, and long-term operating cost efficiency. Experiments on HumanEval Plus, MBPP, MATH-500, and ASQA, spanning agentic code generation, mathematical reasoning, and retrieval-augmented long-form question answering, demonstrate that ProgRouter reduces the operating cost relative to key baselines while maintaining strong task-solving performance.
abstract_zh: 多智能体大语言模型（LLM）工作流通过专门化 LLM agent 的协作推理解决复杂开放任务，但反复调用 LLM 及长期上下文累积带来了较高运行成本。现有级联路由方法通常只在查询级别进行一次性决策，无法适应多步工作流中随任务进展、剩余难度和成本效率要求动态变化的路由需求。本文提出 ProgRouter，一种在线进度引导路由框架，在满足时间与成本预算的同时，自适应地为各工作流步骤选择合适的 LLM agent。ProgRouter 首先设计多视角任务进度评分器，将粗粒度的工作流结果状态与子任务完成度、进度趋势及工作流状态质量等细粒度信号结合起来；随后通过双路径任务进度预测器和自适应元门控机制，估计候选 LLM 带来的进度增益。基于这些估计，ProgRouter 在线逐步执行路由决策，在进度收益、任务时间预算和长期运行成本效率之间进行权衡。在 HumanEval Plus、MBPP、MATH-500 和 ASQA 上的实验覆盖 agentic 代码生成、数学推理及检索增强长文本问答，结果表明，ProgRouter 在保持较强任务性能的同时，相较关键基线能够降低运行成本。
key_points_zh: 针对多智能体 LLM 工作流中的动态路由问题，ProgRouter 将一次性查询级路由扩展为在线逐步决策。
多视角任务进度评分器综合工作流结果状态、子任务完成度、进度趋势和状态质量等信号。
双路径任务进度预测器与自适应元门控机制估计不同候选 LLM 的进度增益。
路由决策同时考虑任务质量、时间预算与长期运行成本效率，实现质量—成本权衡。
在 HumanEval Plus、MBPP、MATH-500 和 ASQA 上验证了较低运行成本与较强任务性能。

llm_assessment.comment: ProgRouter addresses a core orchestration problem by making model routing adaptive to workflow progress, quality, and operating cost.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: ProgRouter针对核心编排问题，使模型路由能够根据工作流进展、质量和运行成本进行自适应调整。
